Synthetic Service Protocol

Document ID: SYNTHETIC-SERVICE-PROTOCOL

Revision: 2

Effective date: 2026-10-20

This revision explicitly supersedes revision 1 of SYNTHETIC-SERVICE-PROTOCOL. Replace the retention requirement of 30 days with 45 days; preserve the older revision as historical evidence.

This document is an invented test policy and makes no claim about any real organization.

Incident review records must be retained for 45 days after closure.

The service owner records a decision, rationale, evidence link, and follow-up owner.

Operational memory means retaining the reason for a decision so another person can apply or challenge it later.

Each review should connect the decision to source evidence and an accountable owner.
